# Emtehani — llms.txt

> Arabic-first school exam platform for teachers and students. Public pages and
> documentation only; learner/teacher records and exam content are private.

## Canonical

- [Home](https://emtehani.vercel.app/): platform overview, features, workflow, FAQ.
- [Markdown home](https://emtehani.vercel.app/agent.md): Markdown representation of the home page.
- [API documentation](https://emtehani.vercel.app/api-docs/): public API onboarding, authentication, rate limits.
- [Authentication guide](https://emtehani.vercel.app/auth.md): JWT bearer model, roles, access limits, OAuth gap.

## API

- [API catalog](https://emtehani.vercel.app/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://emtehani.runasp.net/swagger/v1/swagger.json): generated OpenAPI document.
- [Health](https://emtehani.runasp.net/health): service status.

## Agent discovery

- [AI catalog / ARD manifest](https://emtehani.vercel.app/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
- [ARD manifest alias](https://emtehani.vercel.app/.well-known/ard.json)
- [MCP server card](https://emtehani.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [Agent Skills index](https://emtehani.vercel.app/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)

## Policy

- Public marketing and documentation may be indexed and cited.
- AI training on Emtehani content is not permitted (`ai-train=no`).
- Student, teacher, exam, answer, and result data are private and excluded from all discovery documents.
- No OAuth/OIDC authorization server or dynamic client registration is available.
